gloss: to tell (someone) to; to ask (someone) to; to instruct to

definitions.gloss: to tell (someone) to; to ask (someone) to; to instruct to
definitions.explanation: Used to report an indirect command or request. The speaker conveys what they told or asked someone else to do. Follows the dictionary or nai form of a verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ように{言|い}った。
examples.english: The teacher told us to be quiet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ように{言|い}って⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell him to come soon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ように{言|い}われた。
examples.english: I was told by the doctor not to overdo it.

notes:
Used for indirect speech when reporting that someone was told or asked to do something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [Person ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧] Verb (dict form) + ように{言|い}う: to tell/ask someone to do ~
- [Person ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧] Verb (nai form) + ように{言|い}う: to tell/ask someone not to do ~
- {受身形|うけみけい} ように{言|い}われる: to be told to do ~
- 〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ように{言|い}う: tell someone to do ~
- 〜⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ように{言|い}う: tell someone not to do ~
- 〜ように{言|い}われた: was told to ~
- 〜よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask someone to ~ (softer than 言う)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask someone to — more polite/indirect than 言う
- 〜よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to pass along the message to — used when relaying through a third party
